scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: hierarchical Bayesian model across the 13 service ratings, capturing conditional shared structure (e.g. rating clusters, traveller-type specific effects).

H48_HIERARCHICAL_SIGNAL.question: Does a hierarchical (multi-level) model of the 13 service ratings, with shared priors across rating groups and traveller segments, produce features that improve fold-0 OOF AUC when added to the rich view?
H48_HIERARCHICAL_SIGNAL.method: Fit a Bayesian hierarchical model (via sklearn's BayesianRidge or a custom PyMC3/numbyro if available — but constrained to sklearn for certification). Structure: 13 ratings as outcomes, with group-level effects for (a) rating cluster (WiFi/Entertainment vs Food/Comfort vs Service/Boarding), (b) traveller type (Business/Personal), (c) class (Eco/Business/First). Extract posterior means for each passenger-rating combination as new features (13 × passenger). Cross-fit: fit on folds 1-4, predict fold-0. Add to rich view, LGBM fold-0.
H48_HIERARCHICAL_SIGNAL.leakage: Hierarchical model trained on FIT only (folds 1-4), predicts fold-0. Passenger-level predictions never see their own fold's labels. Fold-safe.
H48_HIERARCHICAL_SIGNAL.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
H48_HIERARCHICAL_SIGNAL.note: Distinct from FEAT 51 (residuals) — this models SHARED STRUCTURE across ratings, not per-rating residuals.

non_goals: No new architecture training beyond the hierarchical model fit (sklearn).
